revisions.text: The world counted you both out, but not only did you endure, you thrived. So it will be today, and when you summon me, you will be rewarded in kind.
Mo and Krill, time and again you've shown that no building is impregnable. Complete the ritual and break me free!
Mo and Krill, your work sustains so many.  And yet you are relegated to the sewers like vermin.  This injustice will end once you complete the ritual.
